events.title: Siria, le Fds curde depongono le armi. Cosa succede ora
events.description: Le Forze Democratiche Siriane, principale formazione armata curda, hanno annunciato la deposizione delle armi dopo anni di conflitto contro lo Stato islamico e per l'autonomia nel nord‑est della Siria.

events.title: Trump eases tariffs on some ground beef products to lower prices

events.title: Ukrainian forces shell DPR populated areas 17 times over past day

events.title: Qatar PM heads to Tehran amid flurry of regional diplomacy

events.description: Australia ha implementado una prohibición total de plataformas como TikTok, YouTube e Instagram para menores de 16 años, marcando un precedente global en la regulación de redes sociales para jóvenes.

events.title: Flash floods devastate villages on the Nepal‑Tibet border

events.title: China, India reaffirm border peace, expand communication channels
events.description: Beijing and New Delhi reaffirmed their commitment to maintain peace in border areas and to enhance communication mechanisms.

events.title: Iranian President says new U.S. sanctions will achieve nothing

events.title: Israeli army shoots Palestinian teen during raid on UN-run center (VIDEO)
